record.paper_title: Ten Conferences WORDS: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: Could the better algorithms be designed for the problems discussed in the paper if in regular F -factorizations only finite languages are considered?

evidence.quote: Could the better algorithms be designed for the problems discussed in the paper if in regular F -factorizations only finite languages are considered?

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface specific results addressing whether restricting regular F-factorizations to finite languages F yields asymptotically better algorithms for the associated decision/counting/optimization problems. The general literature on combinatorics on words (Lyndon factorizations, arch factorizations, etc.) does not seem to directly resolve this question, so the status is not clearly established.

status_evidence.title: Combinatorics on words - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: General overview of factorizations of words; no specific result on improved algorithms for finite-language F-factorizations.
status_evidence.claim: No direct resolution of the finite-language F-factorization algorithmic question is reported.
